export_controls.text: And yet, while the United States has the ability to stop the export of the semiconductors and tools that can be used to create the most powerful AI systems, we can't prevent China from accessing the AI systems themselves. [...] A U.S. company could export AI technology to entities in adversarial nations without any ability for the U.S. to act if it puts our national security at a significant risk.
export_controls.context: House Foreign Affairs Committee markup of the ENFORCE Act (H.R. 8315), a bill to extend export controls to AI systems.

deepseek.reason: The speaker argues the U.S. must be able to restrict AI system exports to adversarial nations.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The statement clearly identifies a gap in export controls and calls for the ability to act.
